segments.title: 開幕致詞
segments.evidence: welcome you all, both in person and online, to the the 2026 agentic AI summit — 開場司儀 Jennifer Chayes 歡迎詞，直接銜接介紹 Rich Lyons 與 Dawn Song 上台致詞

segments.title: 第 1 場次：代理型 AI 基礎設施與平台 - 開幕專題演講
segments.evidence: I'm going to introduce Peter DeSantis from Amazon right now before he comes out to give his keynote speech — 主持人 Todd Graham 明確介紹下一位講者 Peter DeSantis

segments.title: 第 1 場次：代理型 AI 基礎設施與平台 - 精選演講
segments.evidence: We're going to talk to next Sarab, who is the Google VP at DeepMind — Todd Graham 介紹下一位講者，Sarab 為 Saurabh Tiwary 的聽寫誤植

segments.title: 第 1 場次：代理型 AI 基礎設施與平台 - 座談會
segments.evidence: We've got our panelists coming out right now. We're going to do a quick panel on agentic infrastructure and platform — 主持人明確宣布座談會開始

segments.title: 爐邊對談：RSI：揭開「Foom（智能爆炸）」的神秘面紗
segments.evidence: Jaz Seacon, who's going to do a fireside chat, a virtual fireside chat, no actual fire, with Don Song — Jaz Seacon 為 Jasjeet Sekhon 聽寫誤植，且後段提及其 chief strategy officer at Google DeepMind 職稱與 agenda 相符

segments.title: 第 2 場次：軟體工程的未來 - 精選演講
segments.evidence: I'm your session chair for the second session called The Future of Software Development — 新任司儀 Anjney Midha 宣布第 2 場次開始，隨後介紹 Peter Steinberger 等四位講者

segments.title: 第 2 場次：軟體工程 the 未來 - 座談會
segments.evidence: So please grab a seat. Make yourself comfy. We're running a little bit behind. And so we're going to do... we have 14 minutes — 主持人請四位講者入座進行座談會，隨後於下段提及座談名稱 Path to Enlightenment
